about_the_game:
Destroy the Asteroids: Official VR Demo

Earth is on the brink of destruction. Massive asteroids are heading straight for the planet, and hostile alien forces will stop at nothing to block your mission. No reinforcements are coming. It’s just you — humanity’s final line of defense.

🔥 What Awaits You in This Explosive Demo 🔥

🚀 Total Threat
Face brutal waves of asteroids and deadly alien drones. Your aim is the only thing standing between Earth and annihilation.

💣 Insane Weapons
Black hole cannons, guided missiles, precision lasers, and devastating bombs. Choose your method of destruction.

🌌 Escalating Action
Each wave gets harder. Enemies become faster, smarter, and deadlier. Do you have what it takes?

🌕 Cinematic Environment
Fight from the Moon’s surface with Earth looming in the background and the Sun blazing behind you. A breathtaking visual spectacle.

🎧 Reactive Soundtrack
The music adapts to every moment. Feel the tension, the chaos, and the glory with every beat.

Get ready. The demo is just the beginning.
Grab your Oculus and jump in. The planet is counting on you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X or higher
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Meta Quest (Link/AirLink)
  • Additional Notes: Requires SteamVR compatible VR headset
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon 6700 XT or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Meta Quest (Link/AirLink)
  • Additional Notes: Better performance with SSD

short_description: Defend Earth against asteroids and alien ships!Use powerful weapons like lasers, black holes, and missiles to destroy threats and protect the planet. Challenges grow with each wave – only the fastest and most strategic will survive!
